page.layout: One printed page, single column of text. Heading block at top centre: title in spaced capitals, a small "A D" line, and a larger heading line. Below, a verse poem with a historiated initial S at the left. Then a signature block of initials, name and degree, and a Greek-style line, right-aligned. Below that a centred row of asterisks with "IN" at the right, which opens the next division. Digitiser's watermark at bottom right is excluded.

main_text.head: ALLOQUIUM AD Authorem Celeberrimum.
main_text.p: SÆclo, Cognate, dignus hoc Scripto fugis, Ereptus Orbi, quinque bis ævi videns: Peracta Lustra, & annos novem, sic homo est Inane nomen, fumus, aura, vanitas: Solâ superstes mente, quæ cœlum tenet.

page.notes: The initial letter is a decorated woodcut S, joined to the first word; read as "Sæclo", given the verse's sense ("Sæclo" is the printed form, with the initial S forming the first letter of the first word). The first line's opening letter may be "E" or "Æ" under the initial; marked as read. Words in the last line of the signature block are in italic. The asterisks are a printed separator; "IN" begins the following text. The "Dr" abbreviation after Med. is printed as D with a superscript mark. Digitiser's watermark "Digitized by Google" excluded.
